name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard captures 'Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up' — after a fall the hands are empty, so holding_box on the very next step is exactly the pickup, which the fall's auto-facing always allows. Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard captures 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands'; since at_exit holds only on the episode-ending step, the Response closes there when the box is held and stays owed (fails) otherwise, which the machine shows (u2 charged, u0 unchanged when holding_box holds at the exit). Reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so it correctly gets no Existence, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be holding the box at that time.
